purpose: Quantify how unknown store-days could change illustrative quantities, without claiming coverage or imputing historical demand.
previous_evidence: source_audit.json identifies incomplete store-day recording; all forecast results are already development evidence.
scenario: Multiply each frozen selected next-week forecast by 182 divided by that store's observed days in the last 26 weeks, as an illustrative same-rate-on-unknown-days scenario. It is not an estimate of lost sales, and observed transaction days may be selected busy days. Apply identical stock, receipts and supplied ordering policy.
unchanged: No new candidate, no candidate rescoring, no metric or baseline change, no reselection, no reserved outcomes.
interpretation: Exploratory source-assumption sensitivity only, not a confidence interval or recommended replacement quantity.
